applies_to: CAREL heaterSteam UR electric heater steam humidifiers (process and titanium versions) with the c.pHC-based controller, manual +0300087EN.
summary: heaterSteam 4 is CAREL's resistance-heated isothermal steam humidifier; this entry covers the heaterSteam 4 generation documented in manual +0300087EN rel. 1.7 (2025). BACnet MS/TP (on the RS485 BMS port) and BACnet IP (on the Ethernet port) are built into the c.pHC controller, one at a time. The object list has positive-integer values for status, hours, probe and scheduler settings, analog values for probes, set points and production, and binary values for on/off commands, level sensors and every alarm.
notes: Source: section 11.2.3 'Table of BACnet variables', manual pages 55-59 (106 positive integer values, 51 analog values, 91 binary values).

The earlier heaterSteam UR manual (+0300080EN rel. 1.4, 2018) lists 188 objects; most share instance and name with this list, but SV_Command/SV_CommandResult sit at PIV 92/93 there (PIV 72/73 here), a few names differ and 60 objects here are new. See the separate heaterSteam UR (2018) entry.
Temperature, production and probe units follow the unit-of-measure setting (UoM, PIV 45: 1 = °C and kg/h, 2 = °F and lb/h).
Objects ending in NetStatus / Alrm_NetUnit only report in Main/Secondary networks; wireless probe objects only with CAREL wireless probes.
UnitStatus and NetStatus codes are the footnote list printed under the table.

source.title: heaterSteam - UR Electric resistance humidifier - User manual

integration.summary: Pick the port and protocol (Eh01 for the BMS port, Eh06 for Ethernet), set the device instance and UDP port on Eh04, then enable on/off and control from supervisor on Eh07/Eh08. The BMS starts and stops the unit with OnBySV (BV 6) and either sends a production request on SV_PwrReq (AV 11) or writes the humidity set point (AV 14). Monitor OnOffStatus, UnitStatus, current production and the summary alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: CurrProdPh
minimum_points.why: Current steam production, kg/h or lb/h

integration.enable: On screens Eh07/Eh08 select the supervisor port and enable 'On/Off signal from supervisor' and 'control from supervisor' (the BMS-port Eh01 settings 'On/Off from SV' and 'Control from SV' default to No). Without them the unit ignores the supervisor on/off and production request.
integration.heartbeat: Eh08 can enable a supervisor-offline alarm (Alrm_SVOffline.Active, BV 93). The manual does not describe what the unit does with its output when the supervisor goes offline.
integration.remote_sensors: With control from supervisor the BMS sends the production request on SV_PwrReq (AV 11) instead of the unit using its own probe. Up to four CAREL wireless probes can also feed the unit.
setup: Device instance default 77000, UDP port default 47808 (screen Eh04).
BACnet MS/TP on the BMS port: Eh03 sets the MAC address (default 0), max masters (127) and max info frames (10).
Ethernet IP settings (DHCP, IP, mask, gateway, DNS) are on the Ethernet settings screen; select BACnet for the Ethernet port on Eh06.
Only one BACnet instance exists, so BACnet cannot run on the BMS port and Ethernet at the same time.
gotchas: Scheduler, probe range and drain-to-dilute settings are configuration; avoid cyclic writes.
SV_Command (PIV 72) is a one-shot reset (1 = alarms, 2 = hour counter), not a value to hold.
